title: Independent DFT geometry validation of compound 7a
difficulty_reasons: The fixed molecule and selector set require two independent geometry optimizations, stationarity/identity validation, and extraction of 47 mapped observables with circular torsion handling.

paper.title: Synthesis, structural analysis, and computational investigations of 4-(((5-(p-chlorophenoxy)-3-methyl-1-phenyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl) methylene)amino)-5-methyl-4H-1,2,4-triazole-3-thione

data.description: Correct mapped neutral singlet E-imine 7a thione identity, 47 experimental comparison observations, source-label selectors, and explicit global-inversion/circular-error protocol; no computed geometry or ranking.

required_deliverables.description: Validated model calculations and raw artifacts, mapped observations, inversion-normalized per-kind errors, structured primary-pair comparison and evidence-supported conclusion.
